description: Defines the 'phy_time_unit' class which abstracts the physical layer reference time unit T_c used in 3GPP specifications, including methods for conversion, timing calculations, and UL-RTOA measurement reporting. It also includes a utility template for sampling rate calculation based on subcarrier spacing and DFT size.

classes.name: phy_time_unit
classes.description: Represents a physical layer time unit T_c with methods for conversion, timing, and measurement reporting.

methods.name: to_Tc
methods.description: Returns the stored time unit as a multiple of T_c.

methods.name: to_seconds
methods.description: Returns the time in seconds as a floating point value.

methods.name: is_sample_accurate
methods.description: Checks if the time value corresponds to an integer number of samples at a given sampling rate.

methods.name: to_samples
methods.description: Calculates the number of samples for a given sampling rate, asserting if not an integer.

methods.name: to_nearest_samples
methods.description: Calculates the nearest integer number of samples for a given sampling rate.

methods.name: to_Ta
methods.description: Converts the time to units of T_A based on subcarrier spacing.

methods.name: to_ul_rtoa
methods.description: Converts the time to a UL-RTOA measurement report value based on resolution.

methods.name: operator+
methods.description: Adds two phy_time_unit instances.

methods.name: operator+=
methods.description: Adds another phy_time_unit to this instance.

methods.name: operator-
methods.description: Subtracts another phy_time_unit from this instance.

methods.name: operator-=
methods.description: Subtracts another phy_time_unit from this instance.

methods.name: operator*
methods.description: Multiplies the time unit by an unsigned factor.

methods.name: operator*=
methods.description: Multiplies the time unit by an unsigned factor in place.

methods.name: operator/
methods.description: Divides the time unit by an unsigned divisor.

methods.name: operator/=
methods.description: Divides the time unit by an unsigned divisor in place.

methods.name: operator==
methods.description: Checks equality between two phy_time_unit instances.

methods.name: operator!=
methods.description: Checks inequality between two phy_time_unit instances.

methods.name: operator>
methods.description: Checks if this instance is greater than another.

methods.name: operator<
methods.description: Checks if this instance is less than another.

methods.name: operator>=
methods.description: Checks if this instance is greater than or equal to another.

methods.name: operator<=
methods.description: Checks if this instance is less than or equal to another.

methods.name: from_units_of_kappa
methods.description: Creates a phy_time_unit from units of κ.

methods.name: from_units_of_Tc
methods.description: Creates a phy_time_unit from units of T_c.

methods.name: from_timing_advance
methods.description: Creates a phy_time_unit from a timing advance command T_A and subcarrier spacing.

methods.name: from_seconds
methods.description: Creates a phy_time_unit from seconds.
